case_study: August 2026 Trishuli Flood, Nepal (Bhote Koshi Corridor)
reference_source: European Union, Copernicus Emergency Management Service data (EMSR927)

honesty_about_limitations.topographic_challenge: Deep Himalayan gorges create radar shadow on slopes facing away from the satellite, and layover on steep slopes facing the radar. Ground water extent in gorge floors is under-detected without multi-track descending/ascending orbit fusion.
honesty_about_limitations.revisit_time_latency: Sentinel-1 has a 12-day exact repeat orbit over the Trishuli corridor. Radar cannot warn of glacial lake outburst floods minutes before arrival; it serves rapid damage assessment 1-2 days post-event.

mandatory_attribution: Produced using Copernicus Sentinel data 2026. Evaluated against European Union, Copernicus Emergency Management Service data (EMSR927).
